question: Should existing `dinkuskit.inventory.command/v1` opening-balance clients remain compatible via the default reason note, or is rejection of prior note-less v1 payloads intentionally approved?
rationale: The charter locks the new human-facing reason requirement but does not state a compatibility policy for already-valid v1 payloads.

options.title: Preserve v1 compatibility
options.body: Accept a missing v1 `reason.note` as the documented default while requiring explicit editable text in new human-facing flows.

options.title: Version the break
options.body: Introduce a new command schema/version and document the migration if note-less v1 payloads must be rejected.

recommendation.title: Preserve v1 compatibility
recommendation.body: Accept a missing v1 `reason.note` as the documented default while requiring explicit editable text in new human-facing flows.

likelyOwner.reason: Repository policy identifies Bobby as the authority for product locks and approval boundaries.
